Metal Fabrication Services

Solomon Industries LLC provides comprehensive metal fabrication services with state-of-the-art CNC machining capabilities. Our expertise spans precision cutting, forming, welding, and assembly for various industries including manufacturing, construction, and industrial equipment.

Advanced Manufacturing

Precision Metal Fabrication Solutions

Our advanced manufacturing facility combines cutting-edge technology with skilled craftsmanship to deliver superior metal fabrication solutions.

CNC Machining

Advanced CNC machining centers for precise milling, turning, and drilling operations with tight tolerances.

Sheet Metal Fabrication

Complete sheet metal fabrication services including cutting, bending, forming, and welding.

Welding & Assembly

Expert welding services for various materials and comprehensive assembly capabilities.

Capabilities & Equipment

Our state-of-the-art facility is equipped with advanced machinery and skilled personnel to handle diverse fabrication needs.

  • CNC milling and turning with 5-axis capability
  • Precision sheet metal fabrication
  • MIG, TIG, and spot welding
  • Custom metal fabrication and prototyping
  • Large-scale production capabilities
  • Quality control and inspection
  • Surface finishing and treatment
